title: 終幕 あの窓からこぼれる光

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki and I have completed the crucial first three years of her career in the Twinkle Series, and we're basking in our victories.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you happen to be free this weekend? There's somewhere I want to bring you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I am free, so I agree to accompany her. It turns out the place she wanted to bring me is…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! It's an amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wanted to bring you here as thanks for staying by my side and supporting me these past three years!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Here, give me your hand! I'll be your guide today. What kind of rides do you like?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki is enthusiastic about her role as guide. First, she takes me to the merry-go-round…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Look this way! Cheeese!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then to a roller coaster…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I'll be right there with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then we have lunch and watch a parade. We're having a very fulfilling day at the amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That was so scary! They're smart, making you lower your guard and then terrifying you with one last surprise.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's getting late. We should think about leaving soon.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What do you want to do now? Should we round out the day with a ride on the Ferris wheel?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We get in line for the Ferris wheel as the setting sun bathes the park in golden light.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So? Did you have fun today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She regards me with an earnest expression.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew! I've actually been wanting to treat you to a day of fun for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Remember how I was feeling a lot of pressure after I started senior year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must be talking about the time shortly after the Yasuda Kinen. I recall how panicked she was back then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was way past my limits at the time, but I was surprised by how quickly I picked myself up again after speaking with you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A large part of it was because of your encouragement, but it wasn't just that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It was also because I had someone waiting for me in the wings, and just knowing that made me stand taller.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And that wasn't the only time. Right after our final senior race, the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, to be honest, I was thinking how it wouldn't be so bad to take things more slowly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I thought about talking to you about it, but when I came through the runners' tunnel and saw you waiting for me with a smile…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All thoughts about slowing down just… disappeared from my mind.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Instead, I wondered what my next goal should be! What kind of miracle I should show the world!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I believed that with you by my side, I could do anything and go anywhere I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your mere presence gave me the resolution I needed to face the big stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If not for you, I might have stepped down from the stage altogether.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I owe a lot to you. So I wanted to ask…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She grows quiet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will you please stay by my side?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki takes my hand and pulls me up the stairs to the Ferris wheel just as a carriage swings gently to a stop before us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Come on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Outside the carriage, the sky is a swirl of cotton candy reds and blues. The first star of the evening twinkles bright on the shifting tapestry.
